cases.sentence: В двадцать шестом году, в первый ___ месяца.
cases.translation: In the twenty-sixth year, on the first day of the month.
cases.explain: Ordinal expressions with dates use accusative case for the day.

cases.sentence: Сын человеческий, пролей слезы о ___ и всех его полчищах.
cases.translation: Weep for Tyre and all his multitudes.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я соберу против тебя народ, и они обрушатся на тебя, как волны моря, рассеивая в ___ твои стены.
cases.explain: The transitive verb рассеивая requires accusative case for its object.

cases.sentence: Берег твой поколеблется, когда станут жить на ___.
cases.translation: When they live on the island.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location requires prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Восторгаетесь ли вы, жители морского побережья, вы, богатые ___?
cases.translation: Rejoice, O inhabitants, you rich merchants!
cases.explain: Vocative address uses nominative plural form for the addressed group.

cases.sentence: Восторгаетесь ли вы, жители морского побережья, вы, раньше знаменитые, вы, ___?
cases.translation: You who were famous, you were great on the seas!
cases.explain: Nominative plural pronoun used for vocative address.

cases.sentence: Я повергну тебя в ___ , и ты будешь лежать там в мертвых городах.
cases.translation: I will cast you down into the pit.
cases.explain: The preposition в (into) with downward motion requires accusative case.

cases.sentence: Все, кто знает тебя между народами, придут в ужас перед ___.
cases.translation: All who knew you will be appalled at you.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before/in front of) governs instrumental case.

reading.ru: В двадцать шестом году, в первый день месяца, было ко мне слово Господа.
reading.question: When did God's word come to Ezekiel?
options: In the twenty-sixth year, on the first day of the month
In the first year, on the twenty-sixth day
In the last day of the year
reading.correct: In the twenty-sixth year, on the first day of the month
reading.explain: The passage explicitly states the date: the twenty-sixth year, first day of the month.

reading.ru: Я соберу против тебя народ, и они обрушатся на тебя, как волны моря.
reading.question: How will the nations come against Tyre?
options: Like waves of the sea crashing against it
reading.correct: Like waves of the sea crashing against it
reading.explain: God describes the assault on Tyre using the metaphor of waves breaking over it.

reading.ru: Буду оскорблять величие твое, я буду оскорблять славу твою.
reading.question: What will God do to Tyre's greatness and glory?
options: He will bring it low and demean it
reading.correct: He will bring it low and demean it
reading.explain: God will humiliate and dishonor Tyre's pride and reputation.

reading.ru: Восторгаетесь ли вы, жители морского побережья, вы, богатые купцы, вы, любимцы морей?
reading.question: Who is being addressed in this passage?
options: Coastal inhabitants, wealthy merchants, and lovers of the sea
reading.correct: Coastal inhabitants, wealthy merchants, and lovers of the sea
reading.explain: The passage directly addresses the people of the coast, the merchants, and those associated with the sea.

reading.ru: Я повергну тебя в пропасть, и ты будешь лежать там в мертвых городах, подобный древним могилам.
reading.question: What will be Tyre's fate according to this passage?
options: It will be cast down into the pit like ancient ruins
It will be rebuilt and prosperous
reading.correct: It will be cast down into the pit like ancient ruins
reading.explain: God declares Tyre will be overthrown and lie among the dead, like ancient tombs.

reading.ru: Все, кто знает тебя между народами, придут в ужас перед тобой, ты будешь служить предостережением.
reading.question: What will Tyre become among the nations?
options: A warning and object of horror for all nations
reading.correct: A warning and object of horror for all nations
reading.explain: All peoples who knew Tyre will be horrified at its destruction and it will serve as a warning.
